question: Madan Singh Chauhan, also known as ‘Guruji’, is a folk and Sufi singer from _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madan Singh Chauhan ** also known as "Guruji" is a Folk & **Sufi Singer from Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India.**
 
• In 2020**,he received the Padma Shri honour from the Government of India **for his contribution in the field of Art.
 
• **Madan Singh Chauhan** devoted his entire life to music practice. 
 
• He Started his **career with Dholak and then he spent 30 years using the tabla.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Sufi Art: ​

 
• Sufi is a performing art of regional music.
 
• It refers to the devotional music of the Sufis, inspired by the works of Sufi poets like Amir Khusrow, and Khwaja Ghulam Farid.
 
• Sufi music, which is derived from the mystic school of Islam, aims to connect listeners with the Divine.
 
• Qawwali is the best-known form of Sufi music.
 
• Originally, Qawwalis were sung in praise of God. In India Qawwali was brought from Persia around the thirteenth century and Sufis enlisted its services to spread their message.
 
• Amir Khusro (1254-1325) a Sufi and an innovator contributed to the evolution of Qawwali. It is a mode of singing rather than a form of composition.
